item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
With some editing, this could be extremely funny.

As it stands, it's trying way, way too hard. Many of the jokes in here are great — and I expect that's why it's hovering in the positives — but they're mostly lost in a sea of mediocrity.

Author, I encourage you to work on this further. It's got potential.

EDIT: Let me actually be specific. (Keep in mind humor is subjective, so others may not agree.)

Display Commentary
– hide block

I really enjoyed the opening of the SCP. All of it was either funny, or hilarious. Particularly liked "or find true love."

The ogre was dull. The ogre's questions were funny again, though. (Honestly, you could just use a sphinx, since you're doing the sphinx shtick anyway. Or something else unexpected, like a black cat, or a talking donkey once ridden by a wayward prophet.)

Then everything about Termination Protocol 30-Übertöten was dull, forced, unfunny, or not funny enough. You could cut almost all of that and lose nothing, and it's almost a third of the SCP.

(Though the double incineration and flipping off the sun was not bad.)

The black hole generators paragraph was also boring. But I did chuckle when it came to the final joke of the Description. Probably could be polished, but I liked the idea.

The reveal that it's a bacterium is… really dull. You're going for the easy-as-fuck joke that SCP-006-J already did so much better (and other -Js to boot), IE the Foundation freaking out over nothing.

That said, the diet line was also funny. Keep that.

The second paragraph of the Description is also dull.

The third, about the speech, is… eh. You already used the 'speech made out of lethal cognitohazards' joke, and it was funny the first time. The second — meh.

But then: "with no equivalent phrase for "please," "thank you," or "I'm sorry." — was pretty funny.

After that, it's another really dull joke that isn't even a your mom joke (not that it should be, it's just not even as funny as that).

The final addendum is… kind of funny? It's a bit long for the joke, and the "too frivolous and costly" doesn't match the rest of the SCP's joke. It seems there just so you can do the — admittedly sort of funny — joke about slightly fewer being alright. But it's written awkwardly and the joke still doesn't work.

– hide block

item.content:encoded:
Any civilians, non-O5 Foundation personnel, animals, plants, or microbes that have entered Area-100000-J are to be subjected to termination protocol 30-Übertöten.

TP 30-Übertöten is to carried out as follows:

Subject will be incinerated.
Subject's ashes will be double-incinerated.
Incinerator used on subject will be incinerated.
Subject's ashes will be soaked in bleach for five hours.
The bleach-ash solution will be subjected to 50 krads of gamma radiation.
The irradiated bleach-ash solution will be locked in a hermetically-sealed capsule.
The hermetically-sealed capsule will be encased in a block of solid concrete.
The concrete block will be painted with the Latin version of the Lord's Prayer in lamb's blood and stored.
Stored concrete blocks will be placed on a Foundation spacecraft twice monthly and launched into the center of the Sun.
The Sun will be angrily flipped off four times monthly by all members of the O5 council.

And then the Sun will be incinerated.
